newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine car output up 29 pct in July - industry.
newsitem.headline: Argentine car output up 29 pct in July - industry.

text.p: Argentine car production rose 29 percent in July from the same month a year earlier, the ADEFA association of car manufacturers said Tuesday.
Car sales in July in the local market increased 17.8 percent compared with the same month in 1996. In July production was 40,264 units while domestic sales came to 39,549 units, ADEFA said.
ADEFA added that exports in July grew 28.1 percent from July 1996.
Meanwhile, car production in the first seven months of the year increased 38.9 percent compared with the same period a year earlier.
Car sales in the first seven months of the year were up 16.9 percent from the same period in 1996, said ADEFA.
